design_direction.rationale: This is a farm-to-table house restaurant with a genuine story (whole-animal philosophy, named chef, Blackland Prairie ingredients) and strong ratings, so a visitor needs the sense of place and craft, not just another photo-led hero like the last site. Splitting the first screen between the house's evocative name-in-lights and the philosophy text gives it the character-driven, refined feel of a chef-led neighbourhood restaurant, with olive as a warmer, earthier accent than the terracotta already

published.about: Our intention with HT and our whole animal philosophy, is to take that same approach: find these farms and ranches and do the most we can with them while wasting the very least. We want to define Texas Cuisine not by running parallel with a stereotype, but rather by finding these ingredients and using whatever techniques we have in our repertoire to transform them into something exceptional and memorable. We want to determine our cuisine by the food that we can find within our reach. And we grow our culinary culture with those who grow the ingredients for it.

blocks.heading: Philosophy
blocks.text: A culture is built on the food it consumes. Cuisine is a reflection of innovation, necessity, and creativity: it is a form of expression wholly unique to any given culture’s history. Our responsibility is to find the best of what our local farmers, ranchers and artisans have to offer and combine it with the inherent sense of hospitality to our neighborhood to create an exceptional dining experience.

blocks.heading: Chef Rich Vana
blocks.text: Rich Vana is the Chef and Owner of The Heritage Table, which opened in 2013. With a focus on presenting his guests with innovative, yet accessible fare, he dedicates a strong focus to sourcing from local farms and ranches. Having spent time in many kitchens with chefs across Dallas while working as a culinary writer, Rich gained tremendous insight from those who drive the area’s culinary culture. Rich continued this passion he found, and strives daily to build on the culture in Frisco and North Texas.

published.tagline: The Heritage Table is located on Main Street Frisco and is a true neighborhood restaurant with a scratch kitchen serving dinner nightly.

testimonials.author: Francois-Marc Truc
testimonials.text: Lovely restaurant with a rustic exterior and cottage vibes. We had the country-fried chicken and spaetzle, the whole beast and the braised short rib. All we're delicious and would recommend. The portion sizes are small to medium sized. We ended the night with the chocolate silk pie and the buttermilk lemon pie both which were delicious and not too sweet.

testimonials.author: Gabby Sanchez
testimonials.text: Everything was amazing. The staff were so lovely and truly ensured that our meal went smoothly and we felt at home. The chef had touched our table at the beginning of our meal and it was so nice getting to chat with him. I love how many local farms they support it’s incredible! Food was delicious! Love this place, can’t wait to come back!

testimonials.author: Rowland Short
testimonials.text:
We shared many plates with family and thought Chef's slight twists to traditional Southern dishes made for a masterfully presented meal. You can taste the farm to table freshness in every bite from local ingredients and perfect seasoning. The historic home and decor was charming and welcoming, as was service and Chef when we met him at our table.

We recommend everything, but favorites were the fried squash, pork dumplings, beet salad, milk and honey rolls with homemade jam, lamb meatballs, striped bass, beef cheeks (whole beast), fried chicken with spaetzle, silk pie with vanilla ice cream and bread pudding.

Drinks were strong and tasty and we enjoyed the local bourbon recommended to us and local IPAs. We had a great time and the food was rich and filling, yet bright, with perfect hints of acidity and pickling. This is a must try if you are near the north Dallas area. Kudos and cheers, Chef and Heritage Table team!  🙏🏼👍🏼🍻🥟🐟🍖🍗 #eatlocal

testimonials.author: Texas YD
testimonials.text:
Traditional rural home atmosphere.
Food was excellent, recommend the short rib beef.
Chocolate cake, and the bread and butter with jam was excellent.

Nice environment for an intimate date setting or special event for friends and family.

testimonials.author: Kim Huelsing
testimonials.text: This is such a gem of a restaurant! 🤩💎 The food is absolutely incredible. Farm to table and fresh, they even have an adorable garden out back! Have dined here several times and tried different things - the chef hits it out of the park every time! The service is top notch as well. Such friendly servers and excellent management who you can tell really care. The atmosphere is so special too - it’s such a charming place. You can truly see and feel all the cool history, love, and passion for food. Please do yourself a favor and stop by for a meal!
